name: The Beach Club at The Boca Raton
insider_take: This oceanfront sanctuary combines Old Florida glamour with contemporary luxury, where pink Mediterranean architecture meets pristine Atlantic beaches.
whats_special: The Beach Club is part of the historic Boca Raton resort legacy, originally conceived by architect Addison Mizner in the 1920s. The property sits on a quarter-mile of private beach and features the iconic pink palace architecture that Boca Raton is famous for. The resort spans both sides of the Intracoastal Waterway, connected by a private yacht shuttle.
pro_tip: Book a cabana on the beach side early in your stay - they offer the best views of the Atlantic and include dedicated service for the ultimate relaxation experience.
dont_miss: Take the complimentary yacht shuttle between the Beach Club and Yacht Club properties, stroll through the perfectly manicured Mizner-designed gardens, and catch sunset from the oceanfront terrace. The nearby Mizner Park offers upscale shopping and dining just minutes away.
pros: Direct beachfront access with pristine private beach
Multiple dining venues with oceanfront locations
Historic elegance combined with modern amenities
cons: Exclusive atmosphere may feel formal for some guests
